name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard mutual NDA covering confidentiality obligations between two parties sharing sensitive information. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys representing technology vendors, procurement teams, boutique firms, and Big Law.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page template for the Common Paper Mutual NDA. Fill in the bracketed business-specific terms and sign with a counterparty to execute the full agreement by reference to the standard terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Comprehensive agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering subscription terms, order forms, acceptable use, and standard legal protections. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-stage product partnerships where a customer collaborates with a vendor on product design, providing feedback in exchange for early access and other benefits. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard SLA defining uptime commitments, service credits, and support terms. Designed to be used alongside the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Agreement governing professional and consulting services engagements, covering statements of work, deliverables, IP ownership, and payment terms. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Agreement governing the processing of personal data, including GDPR compliance obligations, data subject rights, security measures, and sub-processor management. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Agreement for licensing software products, covering license grants, restrictions, maintenance and support, and intellectual property protections. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement governing reseller, referral, or technology partnership relationships, covering partner obligations, fees, IP ownership, and co-marketing terms. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement for product trials and evaluations, allowing a prospective customer to test a product or service before committing to a long-term deal. Covers scope, duration, fees, and termination. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant agreement governing the handling of protected health information (PHI) by a business associate on behalf of a covered entity, covering permitted uses, safeguards, and breach notification. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum covering AI-specific terms to be incorporated into a broader technology agreement, addressing AI model usage restrictions, data training, output ownership, and liability limitations. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.
